lines.say: Which country gave back almost three times its own size?
1967. After the Six Day War, Israel holds the Sinai. 61,000 square kilometers. Almost three times Israel.
November 1977. Egypt's president, Anwar Sadat, lands in Israel and speaks in the Knesset.
1979: peace. And Israel gives the Sinai back.
The oil fields. Yamit, a whole town, torn down. Even tiny Taba, by 1989.
Sadat paid for peace with his life. 1981.
1994: Jordan. Israel hands back 380 square kilometers, and sends 50 million cubic meters of water a year.
Sinai alone was almost 90 percent of the land Israel took in 1967.
It's a cold peace. Only 5 percent in Egypt and in Jordan back normalization. And the West Bank and Gaza are unresolved.
Land for peace: was it worth it? Tell me below.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
One country did it. Almost three times its own size.

caption_en:
Most people have never heard the end of this story. 🕊️

1967: after the Six Day War, Israel holds the Sinai, about 61,000 km² (Britannica). Israel itself is 22,072 km² (Israel CBS). Almost 3x.
19 Nov 1977: Egypt's President Anwar Sadat lands at Ben Gurion Airport, and speaks in the Knesset (US State Dept, FRUS).
1979: peace treaty. Israel hands back the Sinai: the oil fields (about a quarter of Israel's oil, JTA 1979), the town of Yamit (evacuated and torn down, April 1982), and finally Taba (arbitration 1988, handed over March 1989).
1981: Sadat is assassinated by enemies of the peace.
1994: peace with Jordan, signed in the Arava. Israel hands back about 380 km² and sends 50 million m³ of water a year (treaty Annex II).
Sinai alone was almost 90% of the land Israel took in 1967 (Jewish Virtual Library).

Not perfect: both are a cold peace. Only 5% in Egypt and in Jordan back normalization with Israel (Arab Barometer, Jan 2025). The West Bank and Gaza are still unresolved.

Land for peace: was it worth it? Tell me below.

Sources: Britannica; Israel CBS; US State Dept FRUS 1977 to 1980 vol. VIII; JTA (1979); Taba award (1988); Israel Jordan treaty, Annex II (1994); The Moscow Times (1995); Jewish Virtual Library; Arab Barometer (2025).

caption_he:
מי החזיר פי 3 מהגודל שלו?
ב-1967 ישראל מחזיקה בסיני, כ-61,000 קמ"ר. ישראל עצמה: כ-22,000.
ב-19 בנובמבר 1977 נוחת סאדאת בנתב"ג ונואם בכנסת. ב-1979 נחתם שלום, וישראל מחזירה את סיני: שדות הנפט, העיר ימית, ובסוף גם טאבה.
סאדאת שילם על השלום בחייו, ב-1981. ב-1994 שלום עם ירדן: ישראל מחזירה כ-380 קמ"ר ומעבירה 50 מיליון מ"ק מים בשנה.
לא מושלם: שלום קר, רק 5% במצרים ובירדן תומכים בנורמליזציה, והגדה ועזה עדיין לא פתורות.
שטחים תמורת שלום: היה שווה? ספרו לי בתגובות.
